## Research profile

I study how environmental stress reorganises biological systems across molecular, organismal and ecological scales, and when adaptive responses give way to resilience loss. My research combines field-realistic environmental gradients with molecular ecology, integrative eco-omics and computational approaches to connect biological mechanisms with organismal performance and ecological consequences. I work primarily with aquatic organisms, communities and holobionts while developing reproducible approaches for complex and non-model biological systems.

**Research fields:** Molecular ecology · Environmental stress biology · Systems ecology · Integrative eco-omics

**Methods and observational tools:** Field ecology · Transcriptomics · Physiology · Microbiomes · Metagenomics · Genomics · Proteomics · Environmental bioinformatics · Network analysis · Reproducible computation
